features.name: Copilot Chat
features.description: An open chat interface in Business Central that allows users to look up documentation, understand terminology, and find data within the system. Users can invoke the chat anywhere in the product to ask questions without being distracted from their current task.
features.status_evidence_quote: it's currently in a public preview um and um it's only available in US environments for now
caveats: Only available in US environments currently
Non-blocking and asynchronous - queries may take time to complete

features.name: Marketing Text Suggestions
features.description: An earlier AI feature that generated marketing text, mentioned as the starting point before Copilot Chat was developed.
features.status_evidence_quote: we came up with the idea for the marketing text suggestions at the start uh and obviously we then released that as a feature

features.name: Intent Condensation
features.description: A system that takes the full conversation history and condenses it into a single chat message containing the user's current intent and relevant information, making it easier to pass to other system components.
caveats: Happens invisibly to the user

features.name: Find and Go Capability
features.description: A navigational capability within Copilot Chat that queries the database to find relevant records based on user queries, such as finding sales documents for a specific customer.

features.name: Prompt Engineering with Test-Driven Development
features.description: An approach to developing AI features that involves creating test cases with datasets of inputs representing supported question types and scenarios, using assertions to verify the model routes to the correct skill or handles off-topic queries appropriately.
caveats: Model is a blackbox making testing inherently challenging

features.name: Azure AI Studio Integration
features.description: A tool for prototyping and testing prompts before full implementation, allowing developers to experiment with different prompt formulations and understand model roles.

features.name: Meta Prompt Architecture
features.description: A system where prompts not visible to end users are layered around visible conversation history and user input. The meta prompt contains system instructions that control how the conversation behaves, including conversation history and system prompts that interact with user prompts.
caveats: Term described as 'fluffy' - implementation details may vary

features.name: Jailbreak Prevention
features.description: Security measures that prevent users from manipulating the AI model through prompt injection attacks. The system uses user roles versus system roles to distinguish trusted instructions from untrusted user input, wrapping user input in user prompts while reinforcing scope through system prompts.
caveats: users can write any input in chat feature
ongoing technical challenge
Security approach described as ongoing challenge
Effectiveness not empirically proven in this discussion

features.name: Harmful Input Dataset Testing
features.description: A dataset of thousands of potentially harmful inputs is run through the Copilot Chat test suite to ensure the feature produces appropriate responses and does not surface undesirable outputs.
caveats: large portion of harmful inputs dismissed as off-topic without deep testing

features.name: LLM-Powered Jailbreak Simulation
features.description: Two LLMs are set to interact with each other - one is Copilot Chat and the other attempts to produce harmful content using known jailbreak prompts. This simulates adversarial conversations to uncover bugs before customer exposure.
caveats: requires refining harmful inputs to Business Central context to test effectively

features.name: Automated LLM-Based Response Evaluation
features.description: A third LLM evaluates whether Copilot Chat responses are appropriate according to predefined harm categories, allowing automatic grading of thousands of simulated conversations without manual review.
caveats: manual grading not scalable
model behavior changes with upgrades
requires automation due to rapid model release cycles

features.name: Prompt Engineering for AI Features
features.description: Development of Copilot Chat involves significant prompt engineering work alongside traditional code. As models improve, the ratio is expected to shift toward more prompt-based logic and less conventional code wrapping around model outputs.
caveats: difficult to quantify exact time split
requires test-driven approach due to model opacity
much code currently needed to validate model output types

features.name: LLM-Assisted Prompt Improvement
features.description: Users can pass their prompts through an LLM to improve language precision, fix grammatical issues, and ensure the text maps more closely to training data, resulting in better prompt performance.
caveats: technique for non-native English speakers
manual refinement still needed

features.name: Copilot Developer Tools
features.description: A toolkit for Business Central that provides boilerplate code, model calling capabilities, and consistent UI elements aligned with Microsoft Office products. Helps developers get started with AI feature development quickly.
caveats: documentation and links to be provided

features.name: Prompt Storage in Key Vault
features.description: For AppSource extensions, prompts can be stored in Key Vault to protect intellectual property. This prevents prompts from being visible in the extension code when distributed.
caveats: prompts are considered IP and need protection
approach specific to AppSource extensions
